response_audit.evidence: The false universal strictly-increasing claim is retracted, its counterexample is reproduced, and the linear-family iff is mathematically correct. The declared 264 grid cells, 800 randomized checks, and an independent 800-case exact-arithmetic adversarial family all pass. Residual: Proposition 1 remains tagged machine-checked although the executable checker covers finite n=3 samples, not the stated arbitrary-n continuous theorem.

All 3,478 substituted lines carry pre_evidence_ids and substitute_source.buffer_write_eid, and Proposition 4 now disclaims byte reconstruction. Residual: the ID is recomputed at substitution time from key/value, no durable buffer write history or store locator exists, and only 62 unique IDs cover 3,478 substitutions, so it cannot identify a specific write event.
The body, abstract, claims table, and appendix state sufficiency only. The old necessity direction appears only in explicit retraction/counterexample discussion.

CH1 now audits the exact in-memory Phase II EvidenceRecord objects and persists those same full records. Residual: audit_executed runs before _write_outputs and never reloads the persisted *-exec-evidence.jsonl required by the round-two probe.

All ten registry entries were re-fetched; title and first-author pairs match, using Crossref or the registered alternate page where DOI publisher pages blocked extraction. The populated paper contains zero [CITE: tokens.
Runtime scipy t.ppf(0.975,29)=2.045229642132703 is used. Every recomputed mean and interval matches the sweep summary; maximum absolute delta is 1.11e-16, below 1e-6.

verdicts.note: The corrected linear-family theorem is true and all finite/adversarial probes pass; the machine-checked tag exceeds executable scope.
The implemented S4 existential construction reproduces across 30 seeds; it is correctly scoped away from arbitrary remediators.
Current Phase II/join structure supports the claim under Lemma 1, but Theorem 1's machine tag is broader than the lattice checker and the exact-evidence audit is not a persisted-file replay.
Schema v2 supplies identity commitments, not bytes. Verification/resolution remains conditional on stores not implemented here, and the write ID cannot distinguish repeated identical write events.
No-manufactured-coverage holds definitionally because composed detection is the union of member flags.
Zero false holds reproduces for the declared synthetic label-derived population, not as a general selectivity theorem.
Pinned engines bootstrap at the declared SHAs and remain git-clean.

Full reproducibility fails on current HEAD: formal artifacts are committed with the prior review SHA, the populated paper reports stale 140/200 rather than current 145/200, and one selected seed differs by one ULP.
Zero violations reproduces and exact in-memory executed evidence is audited, but persisted evidence is not reloaded.
Every seed meets the registered divergence and direction rule.
Zero false holds reproduces within the declared simulator population.
Coverage honesty reproduces but is constructed directly from member flags.
125 profiles x 264 cells reproduce; maximum is 48 compensatory admissions.
W1 mitigation support reproduces; W2 fails the every-seed rule and the paper states that limitation.
86/243 grid non-confluence and independent 159/200 off-grid non-confluence reproduce through actual code; the paper's current-HEAD off-grid number is stale.
The registered readout reproduces: CH1-CH5 robust, CH6 not robust under the all-workflow condition.

scores.justification: The two severity-1 overclaims were substantively corrected and statistics/citations are strong, but proof tags still overstate executable scope and current-HEAD paper evidence is stale.

Tests, schema validation, pinned engines, mutation calibration, and exact in-memory audit evidence are strong; deductions reflect build ordering/stale artifacts, absent persisted-audit replay, and a one-ULP deterministic replay miss.
